notes: the compiler's father is written only as «أبي», so the first link is a relation
«أبي عبد الله» is written after «عن» inside the chain, so it is a narrator
«وَجَدْتُ فِی بَعْضِ الْکُتُبِ» is a first-person saying of the Imam with an unnamed book behind it: a first-person narrative with implicit transmission (rule 11)
